model.name: H3 Fused 4-Step — Frames (Experimental)
model.description: Experimental all-in-one MiniMax H3 Frames checkpoint with the FL2VA-to-Ref2VA rank-1024 delta, LightX2V Turbo, Mystic, and native INT8 ConvRot weights already fused. It supports text, start/end/timed frames, audio-driven video, control video, and sliding windows in four model evaluations by default, with an experimental 4-8 step adjustment. SLA sparse attention is enabled by default when the runtime supports it and falls back safely to dense attention.
model.selector_help:
FASTH3 PREVIEW
A single pinned 21 GB INT8 ConvRot checkpoint provides the Frames workflow. The published recipe defaults to four evaluations with res_multistep, video shift 12, audio shift 3, and no CFG. Advanced exposes 4-8 Total Steps for optional extra refinement; four remains the recommended speed preset. Turbo and Mystic are already baked into the checkpoint: do not add another Turbo preset or LoRA. SLA is enabled by default on compatible CUDA/Triton systems; turn it off for a dense reference run. This is an experimental community checkpoint, not an official MiniMax release.
model.inference_steps_help: 4 is the published speed preset. Try 5-6 for a little more refinement; 8 is the checkpoint's slower high end.
